head: ChatGPT Plus free for veterans: over 20,000 have claimed a free year
dek: OpenAI says more than 20,000 US veterans and transitioning service members have claimed a year of ChatGPT Plus at no cost since the offer started. It shared the number ahead of Veterans Day, with more free trainings planned in November.
details: When OpenAI launched the offer in November 2025, it covered service members and veterans within 12 months of retirement or separation, with registration on ChatGPT's veterans claim page; Plus normally costs 20 dollars a month. OpenAI and partners have held more than a dozen trainings for nearly 1,000 military community members. Upcoming events include St. Louis on 12 November, Nashville on 14 November, a 30-minute online session on 17 November, Dallas on 19 November and San Antonio on 21 November, with seven more before the end of 2026. The offer isn't run by the VA or the Department of Defense.
where: US service members and veterans within 12 months of leaving the service
means: If you left the US military in the last year, or are about to, you may be able to get ChatGPT Plus for a year without paying.
todo: Check the terms and register on ChatGPT's veterans claim page (chatgpt.com/veterans-claim) with the account you want the year on.
